A skip is legitimate — rev92(d) has no formal-model content and forcing prose there would be the patch this repo rejects — but it must be a DECISION, not an absence. See thelabmd/UST-Protocol#99. Records are keyed by `rev` for the CLOSED reference-checker ladder (historical) or by `round` for the LIVE version-line counter. A round is accounted where the work is recorded, not where a finished audit arc used to be.
